newsitem.title: USA: IKON accepts fiscal Q2 estimates.
newsitem.headline: IKON accepts fiscal Q2 estimates.

text.p: IKON Office Solutions Inc investor relations manager Susan Gaffney told Reuters the firm was comfortable with analysts estimates the firm will earn $0.35-$0.38 a share in the second quarter of the fiscal year to September 1997.
"We're comfortable in that range," she said after a presentation to an Emerald Asset Management investment seminar.
Gaffney also said analysts estimates that the firm would earn around $1.53 to $1.55 a share for the full year were in line with the company's expectations of 35-40 percent earnings growth.
